title: Innate Pharma announces conference call and webcast
body_markdown:
** Fri, 08/14/2026 - 11:30


Innate Pharma SA (Euronext Paris: IPH; Nasdaq: IPHA) (“ **Innate** ” or the “ **Company** ”), today announces that the Company will hold a conference call on Friday, August 14, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. CEST / 8:00 a.m. EDT.


Participants during the call will be:


- Jonathan Dickinson, Chief Executive Officer
- Yannis Morel, Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer
- Frédéric Lombard, Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer
- Stéphanie Cornen, Vice President, Investor Relations, Communication


**Event Details**
The live webcast will be available at the following link:
[https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/322508798](https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/322508798)


Participants may also join via telephone using the following registration link:[https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/322508798?pwd=Cl4ian4X](https://events.q4inc.com/analyst/322508798?pwd=Cl4ian4X)


This information is also available on the Investors section of the Innate Pharma website,[www.innate-pharma.com](https://www.innate-pharma.com/) . A replay of the webcast will be available on the Company website.
